newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Somali militiamen attack aid vehicle, kill one.
newsitem.headline: Somali militiamen attack aid vehicle, kill one.

text.p: Militiamen attacked a vehicle from an Italian aid agency in the central Somalia town of Belet-Tuen on Friday, killing one person and wounding five, witnesses said.
They said the attack was carried out by militiamen loyal to the self-proclaimed president, Ali Mahdi Mohamed.
The dead person was a Somali woman caught in a crossfire between the militiamen and bodyguards in the vehicle, the witnesses said. Two Somali militiamen were also wounded.

Somalia in the Horn of Africa has been without central administration since 1991 when rebels ousted dictator Mohamed Siad Barre. The rebels then turned on each other in battles that laid waste to the country.
